== Title ==
<span lang="ja">気絶に陥るリーダー</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">屋内の位置カードで戦闘が宣言された直後に使用する。1フォース消費して、双方の側のすべてのリーダーと能力値＞2のキャラクターを完全にその戦闘から切り離す。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ストームトルーパーは重要な目標を殺さずにスタン（気絶）させる訓練を受けている。これは敵軍を分断し、リーダーを捕まえて尋問するためである。スタンに後遺症はなく、その後の尋問にも支障は出ない。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Stunning Leader]].

'''Lore''' — Stormtroopers are trained to stun (knock unconscious) important targets without killing them. This is to split the enemy and capture leaders for interrogation. Stun has no aftereffects and does not hinder later interrogation.

'''Game text''' — Use immediately after a battle is declared at an interior location card. Spend 1 Force to completely cut all leaders and characters with ability greater than 2 on both sides out of that battle.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The Japanese uses 位置カード where the English says interior site. The Japanese lore says stun has no aftereffects and does not hinder interrogation; the English says stun effects wear off and require efficient action.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-stunningleader-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Stunning Leader]].</ref>
